answers.reason: The elected student representative is a member of the faculty and takes part only where their faculty matters are decided.
The elected student representative does not sit in central budget bodies.
The elected student representative is not specified as a member of the appointment committee.
The elected student representative speaks for the students of the faculty in its bodies.
The elected student representative participates in faculty teaching and study matters.
The examination board decides on individual examination matters and does not include the student representative by default.
The internal research funding round is for research grants, not student representation matters.
The module revision working group deals with specific degree programme modules rather than general student representation.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled by researchers or staff rather than the student representative.
The elected student representative speaks for students, but orientation week planning is a specific separate planning round.
